title: Rakhi
desc: An ambitious and young man named Rama Krishna avenges his sister's death after her in-laws burn her alive due to their greed for dowry. Thereafter, he starts killing every man that harasses a woman.

title: Vaa Magale Vaa
desc: Lawyer Uma takes up the case of Raman, a mechanic who has been framed for murder. She soon learns that the prime suspect is her own father, Vishwanath, whom she has always held in high esteem.

title: Paayum Puli
desc: A man with mental challenges decides to join a martial arts school in order to hone his fighting skills and avenge the murder of his sister.

title: Jallikattu
desc: Arjun, traumatised by the massacre of his entire family, seeks revenge but gets caught. Later, Ram Prakash, the judge presiding over his case, decides to help him.

title: Pattas
desc: When a petty thief finds out about his family's tragic past and Adimurai, an ancient martial art form, he decides to fulfil his destiny and avenge his family's oppressors.
